diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_function.ami_housekeeper is configured with a vpc_config (active whenever var.lambda_subnet_ids is non-empty), which requires the execution role to already have the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole policy so Lambda can create ENIs. The function only depends on aws_iam_role.ami_housekeeper (the bare role), not on aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ami_housekeeper_vpc_execution_role. If Terraform creates the function before that attachment, function creation fails with "The provided execution role does not have permissions to call CreateNetworkInterface". Add depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ami_housekeeper_vpc_execution_role].

The execution role only receives the AMI-cleanup permissions the function needs from aws_iam_role_policy.ami_housekeeper, but aws_lambda_function.ami_housekeeper does not depend on it. Nothing orders the policy attachment before the function is created/invoked, so the function can run without its core permissions. Ensure the role's policies are in place before the function by adding depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy.ami_housekeeper].

When tracing is enabled (var.tracing_config.mode != null), the function needs the X-Ray permissions granted by aws_iam_role_policy.ami_housekeeper_xray, but aws_lambda_function.ami_housekeeper does not depend on it. Ensure the X-Ray policy is attached before the function runs by adding depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy.ami_housekeeper_xray].
